name: stat
summary: Shows a file's inode metadata: size, permissions, owner and the three timestamps.
description: The -c format gives exactly the fields you want on one line, which is useful for a timeline. Access, modify and change times are %x %y %z.

params.label: Format

choices.label: times + path
choices.explain: name, access, modify and change times

choices.label: owner, perms, size, path
choices.explain: owner, group, octal permissions, size, name

params.desc: %n name, %s size, %a octal perms, %U user, %G group, %x access, %y modify, %z change, %i inode, %h links.
